opening.argument: The presentation centers on Nirvana Surfboards' business story: it shows the shop and discusses where its boards are made and how production keeps their dimensions consistent. The accompanying description identifies the video as a small-business owner's story and advice for other owners. Citibank enters that account through support for international transactions and a conversation about a business line of credit. Those references remain part of the testimonial. The supplied material shows no request for viewers to transfer money or provide credentials, no promised investment return, and no deceptive mechanism or scam flow. It is an account of ordinary business operations and banking support, not a solicitation built around those elements.
